scalars.scalar_value: An associate degree or equivalent college units (60 semester or 90 quarter units from a recognized college or university) AND three years working with the public in community development fund raising, marketing or institutional advancement activities.

items.item_text: 01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to be qualified. The application will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Your responses to the supplemental questions below may also be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification in a training and experience (T&E) evaluation. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response to any question. Questions that are answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Ventura County Community College District (VCCCD). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. What is your highest level of education? Options: High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Some college coursework, but less than 60 semester or 90 quarter units | Associate Degree or two years of college-level coursework (60 semester or 90 quarter units) | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree | None of the above

03. How many years of professional experience do you possess working with the public in community development, fundraising, marketing, or institutional advancement activities? Options: Less than one year | At least one year, but less than two years | At least two years, but less than three years | At least three years, but less than four years | At least four years, but less than five years | Five or more years

04. In which of the following areas have you performed work-related responsibilities? Select all that apply. Options: Planning and coordinating special events | Donor cultivation, stewardship, or recognition | Community outreach and partnership development | Marketing, public relations, social media campaigns or promotional communications | Maintaining donor, prospect, or community contact databases | Supporting a nonprofit foundation, board, or similar organization | Developing sponsorship opportunities or coordinating sponsorships | None of the above

05. Which statement best describes your highest level of responsibility for coordinating special events? Options: I have attended or participated in events, but have not been responsible for planning or coordination. | I have assisted with specific event activities, such as registration, communications, setup, or logistics. | I have independently coordinated major components of events, including scheduling, logistics, communications, or stakeholder coordination. | I have served as the primary coordinator for events, managing planning, budgets, logistics, stakeholders, and post-event evaluation. | None of the above.

06. Which statement best describes your experience supporting fundraising or donor relations activities? Options: I have no direct experience in fundraising or donor relations. | I have provided administrative or logistical support for fundraising or donor relations activities. | I have independently coordinated fundraising activities, donor communications, or donor recognition efforts. | I have independently coordinated multiple fundraising or donor engagement initiatives, including developing strategies, managing relationships, and evaluating outcomes.

07. Which statement best describes your experience developing and maintaining relationships with external organizations? Options: I have no direct experience working with external organizations or community partners. | I have provided administrative or logistical support for fundraising or donor relations activities. | I have independently coordinated fundraising activities, donor communications, or donor recognition efforts. | I have independently coordinated multiple fundraising or donor engagement initiatives, including developing strategies, managing relationships, and evaluating outcomes.

08. Which statement best describes your experience developing communications or promotional materials for external audiences? Options: I have no experience developing external communications or promotional materials. | I have assisted with editing, formatting, or distributing materials prepared by others. | I have independently developed invitations, outreach communications, promotional materials, or donor correspondence. | I have independently developed and coordinated communication materials for multiple initiatives, ensuring consistency with organizational messaging and audience needs.

09. Which statement best describes your experience maintaining databases or systems used to track donors, community contacts, sponsorships, or organizational relationships? Options: I have no experience maintaining these types of databases. | I have entered or updated information in an existing database. | I have regularly maintained records, generated reports, and monitored data accuracy. | I have managed database processes, developed tracking or reporting procedures, and analyzed information to support organizational initiatives.

10. Describe your experience supporting or coordinating fundraising, donor cultivation, donor stewardship, sponsorships, or other institutional advancement activities. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Length(s) of employment. If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

11. Describe a specific initiative in which you helped establish, develop, or maintain a relationship with a business, community organization, nonprofit, foundation, or other external partner. Explain your role, the steps you took, and the results of the partnership. If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

12. Describe the most complex event or community engagement activity you have helped plan or coordinate. Include the purpose of the event, the number and types of stakeholders involved, your responsibilities, challenges encountered, and how you evaluated its success. If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

13. Describe a situation in which you were responsible for coordinating multiple projects, events, or initiatives with competing deadlines. Explain how you established priorities, communicated with stakeholders, and ensured that the work was completed successfully. If no experience in this area, list "NA".

An associate degree or equivalent college units (60 semester or 90 quarter units from a recognized college or university) AND three years working with the public in community development fund raising, marketing or institutional advancement activities.

Provide leadership and coordination of various activities, programs and special events associated with the college’s institutional advancement and community relations programs. E Assist in organizing, developing and implementing all activities associated with the college’s institutional advancement and community development programs. E Provide operational and programmatic support for donor cultivation and stewardship, fundraising initiatives, sponsorship opportunities, alumni and community relations, special events, and other advancement activities designed to strengthen the College’s relationships with individuals, businesses, foundations, community organizations, and other external partners. E Coordinate with College departments, administrators, faculty, staff, donors, volunteers, and community partners to facilitate successful programs and events; assist with event logistics, Develop information and promotional materials for distribution to the public and prospective donors. Including communications, outreach, invitations, sponsorship materials, donor recognition, and follow-up; working with Moorpark College marketing team to ensure consistent messaging and ADA compliance. E Manage and maintain the prospect and donor database, including donor and prospect records and the donor recognition system. E Maintain accurate records and supporting documentation; and help identify and develop opportunities that increase community awareness, philanthropic support, and engagement with the College and its programs. E Work with college staff, representative of various constituent groups, members of the College Foundation Board, other organizations, committees and volunteer groups in the planning and design of activities and initiatives in the college’s institutional advancement and community development programs. E Represent the college to the community. E Provide assistance to the President’s Office by assisting with the activities and functions of the College Foundation. E Oversee campus entrepreneurial efforts and campus events (e.g. farmers markets). E Work collaboratively and professionally with faculty, staff, students, and stakeholders from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, and ethnic communities. E Demonstrate cultural humility, sensitivity, and equity-mindedness in working with individuals from diverse communities; model inclusive behaviors; and achieve equity in assignment-related outcomes. E Perform other duties as assigned. E = Essential duties.
